summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a parametrized test plus two small extra tests. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (43 passed). No new line exceeds 88 columns. mypy, ruff, and black are not installed in the shared venv, so type-check and formatting were verified by reading only. Nothing was committed.
